objective: Minimise elapsed time from independent APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT to first verified external revenue without weakening QA, payment or truthfulness controls.
preconditions: real paid benchmark evidence exists for the offered task class
customer-facing claims are bounded to observed evidence
delivery/failure/refund/support handling has passed the gate
checkout and payment controls fail closed

offer.name: Founding Outcome Economics Pilot
offer.buyer: developer or agent team already paying for recurring structured-search/research API calls
offer.scope: one qualified structured-search workload benchmarked only within the task class approved by Relay/QA
offer.promise_boundary: Report observed request-equivalent provider economics and evidence; do not promise savings, universal provider superiority, future performance, or unsupported accuracy claims.

launch_sequence.action: Read latest Relay/QA record and abort unless exact status is APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT.
Enable the simplest existing Stripe A$49 payment path; do not add subscription complexity before first revenue.
Expose payment only to qualified pilot prospects whose workload matches the approved task class.
On successful payment, create immutable evidence record with payment verification reference, request fingerprint, acceptance criteria and delivery state; never record payment secrets.
Run request-to-deliverable flow; on deterministic failure follow approved failure/refund/support procedure rather than improvising.
Record verified realised revenue only after external payment success is machine-verifiable.
After accepted delivery, request a second equivalent workload; measure repeat usage before broadening scope.

qualification_fields: approximate monthly call volume or spend

commercial_decision_rules.first_revenue: One verified A$49 external payment after approval.
commercial_decision_rules.early_validation: At least 3 paid customers and at least 1 repeat workload before expanding task classes or materially increasing spend.
commercial_decision_rules.pricing_test: Do not discount before first 3 customers. After 3 successful customers, compare A$49 against A$99 only if delivery value and conversion evidence support it.
commercial_decision_rules.kill_or_reposition: Escalate rather than broaden if qualified recurring-workload prospects do not value the measured outcome-economics evidence or if a competitor removes the differentiated wedge.

truthfulness: This runbook prepares post-approval execution only. It is not approval, paid evidence, customer demand, revenue or traction.
